A design observation about the IS NOT NULL elision introduced at the checkpoint (SqlNullabilityProcessor.cs:578-591, 595-615) and about SqlExpressionFactory.IsNull/IsNotNull, both present.

The substance holds at the checkpoint: SqlNullabilityProcessor.cs:626-630 recurses into both operands of every SqlBinaryExpression, and ExpressionType.Coalesce is a valid SqlBinaryExpression operator (SqlExpressions/SqlBinaryExpression.cs:102), so DropNotNullChecks can drop a needed IS NOT NULL; only the method name and the 'except AndAlso/OrElse' clause describe the later revision.
